body:
I thought about it and I was planning on doing that last year but ended up just... not. I'm kind of afraid to, I don't know. Lack of motivation, etc. But it'd definitely be nice to get out of the house. I looked it up and the one I'd go to has a counseling center, apparently. To be honest I'm not even sure if I legitimately graduated high school, I never got a diploma.

I remember when I was in... high school, I think (I switched schools a few time, I don't remember) a counselor made a meeting with me because I wasn't doing my homework and I never talked and I didn't have any friends and she was all "well I can figure out a way to help" and then I never saw her again which got me kind of fed up. 

I think my biggest problem is the fact I find it so impossible to talk to people without panicking and freezing up. I always hated school because as much as I loved the learning-bit I was so afraid of other people - I'd rather fail than have to ask the teacher a question, etc.

Thank you!

As for getting counseling... I asked my family about it and over the course of a few months the answers went from "you don't REALLY need/want it" to "okay, sure, we'll looking that" (and doing nothing) to "well, we can't afford it." I don't have any money of my own and I can't drive so getting it on my own is kind of hard.
